subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw add a new Channel Broker SDK/bundled plugin and conformance harness, or keep shared channel conformance on the existing channel-inbound/channel-outbound contracts?
rationale: Both paths affect public plugin API, channel delivery semantics, config, and security boundaries; the linked broad implementation was explicitly closed pending maintainer-approved design, so automation should not pick the architecture.

options.title: Approve a Narrow Design First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the broker boundary, then ask for a smaller design or PR that only implements the approved conformance surface.

options.title: Use Existing Channel Contracts
options.body: Retarget the work to expand `channel-inbound`, `channel-outbound`, and `channel-contract-testing` fixtures without introducing a separate broker SDK/plugin.

options.title: Reject Separate Broker Work
options.body: Close this tracker if maintainers decide broker routing is not part of OpenClaw’s channel architecture for now.

recommendation.title: Approve a Narrow Design First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the broker boundary, then ask for a smaller design or PR that only implements the approved conformance surface.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc made the explicit maintainer-side closure decision on the linked broker stack and has recent adjacent channel history.
